thread:
Sam: Quick pack — one-line goal statement templates for ICs. Copy/paste friendly.
Jordan: Nice. Can we include a single "measure" line for managers to glance?
Sam: Yep. Pattern: 1) One-line goal. 2) Why it matters (1 phrase). 3) Metric + target. 4) Support needed (1 line).
Maria: Examples please (PM/Eng/Support).
Sam: Eng example: 'Reduce median API inference latency from 120ms to 80ms by end of Q3 to improve user conversion. Measured by p50 latency -> target 80ms. Support needed: infra quota for dedicated GPU pool.'
Sam: PM example: 'Increase feature activation for Smart Replies from 8% to 15% by Q4 to raise retention. Measured by activation rate -> 15%. Support needed: analytics event and sample prompts for evaluation.'
Sam: Support example: 'Improve first-response accuracy on inference incidents from 72% to 88% by Q3 to lower MTTR. Measured by incident QA pass rate -> 88%. Support needed: rotation time for deep-dive postmortems.'
Leo: Loving the brevity. Can we also add a 30s elevator line variant for skip-levels?
Sam: 30s elevator template: 'I led X (what) to achieve Y (outcome) which moved metric Z by N%, and next I'm focused on A to scale it.'
Jordan: Manager coaching prompts (tiny bank) — add these to the pack? 1) "What's blocking this goal?" 2) "How will we know it's done?" 3) "What tradeoffs are we okay with?" 4) "Who needs to be involved?"
Maria: Self-review starter (one-liner + learning): 'I shipped X, which resulted in Y (metric/outcome). Learned: Z. Next: A.'
People Ops Bot: Saved copy to drive -> https://drive.redwood/example/goal-one-pagers (permission: team read).
Sam: I'll turn this into a tiny checklist and drop into the OKR template repo today. @Jordan can you review wording for "measure" lines?
Jordan: Yep, will review this afternoon. :thumbsup:
Leo: I'll add a quick example for optimization-focused ICs and ping when done.
Sam: Thanks all — closing the thread, will post final pack to handbook by EOD.
